for item in checked: check(item)

nr=reference_plan["inputs"]["checkpoint_gene_names.txt"]
sr=reference_plan["inputs"]["checkpoint_gene_to_species.npy"]

names=Path(nr["path"]).read_text().splitlines()

index={g:i for i,g in enumerate(names)}
trace=snapshot["structural_controls"]["control"]["copy_split_trace"]
checked.append(trace)
events=json.loads(Path(trace["path"]).read_text())["events"]
families=[(ordinal,event) for ordinal,event in enumerate(events) if event["large_copy_eligible"]]
assert len(events)==470 and len(families)==251
family_owner=np.full(n,-1,dtype=np.int32)
for ordinal,event in families:
    members=event["members"]
    assert members==sorted(set(members)) and len(members)==event["size"]
    assert np.all(family_owner[members]==-1)
    family_owner[members]=ordinal
payload=Path(plan["data"]["graph"]["payload"])
payload_refs=[r for r in plan["inputs"] if Path(r["path"]).parent==payload]
checked.extend(payload_refs)
assert {Path(r["path"]).name for r in payload_refs}>={"gene_names.txt","sources.i32","targets.i32","weights.f64"}
for item in checked: check(item)
assert (payload/"gene_names.txt").read_text().splitlines()==names
assert saved_fingerprint(payload)==plan["data"]["graph"]["fingerprint"]
a=np.memmap(payload/"sources.i32",dtype=np.int32,mode="r")
b=np.memmap(payload/"targets.i32",dtype=np.int32,mode="r")
weights=np.memmap(payload/"weights.f64",dtype=np.float64,mode="r")
assert len(a)==len(b)==len(weights)==25592162
adjacency=defaultdict(set)
accepted_edges=0
previous=-1
for start in range(0,len(a),1000000):
    aa=a[start:start+1000000];bb=b[start:start+1000000];ww=weights[start:start+1000000]
    assert np.all(aa>=0) and np.all(bb<n) and np.all(aa<bb)
    assert np.all(np.isfinite(ww)) and np.all(ww>0)
    packed=aa.astype(np.int64)*n+bb
    assert int(packed[0])>previous and np.all(packed[1:]>packed[:-1])
    previous=int(packed[-1])
    fa=family_owner[aa];fb=family_owner[bb]
    selected=(fa>=0)&(fa==fb)&(ww>=1.5)
    accepted_edges+=int(selected.sum())

        u=int(u);v=int(v);adjacency[u].add(v);adjacency[v].add(u)

component_sizes=[]

for ordinal,event in families:
    components=refinement._split_index_cluster_by_components(event["members"],adjacency)
    assert sorted(g for c in components for g in c)==event["members"]
    components=sorted((sorted(c) for c in components),key=lambda c:c[0])
    family_components[ordinal]=components
    for c in components:
        assert np.all(component_owner[c]==-1)
        component_owner[c]=len(component_sizes)
        component_sizes.append(len(c))
assert np.array_equal(component_owner>=0,family_owner>=0)
fasta=Path(plan["data"]["fasta_directory"])
pins={r["path"]:r for r in plan["inputs"] if Path(r["path"]).parent==fasta}

owners={}
filenames=sorted(fetch_fasta_files(str(fasta)))
assert len(filenames)==78
for filename in filenames:
    path=fasta/filename
    assert str(path) in pins
    item=pins[str(path)];check(item);checked.append(item)
    for sequence in SeqIO.parse(str(path),"fasta"):
        assert sequence.id in index and sequence.id not in owners and len(sequence)>0
        owners[sequence.id]=filename
        lengths[index[sequence.id]]=len(sequence)
ownership=validate_ownership(names,species,owners)
assert np.all(lengths>0)
def composition(members):
    copies=Counter(int(species[i]) for i in members)
    ll=lengths[members]
    return {"genes":len(members),"species":len(copies),"maximum_species_copies":max(copies.values()),"length_min":int(ll.min()),"length_p10":float(np.quantile(ll,.1)),"length_median":float(np.median(ll)),"length_p90":float(np.quantile(ll,.9)),"length_max":int(ll.max())}
counts=Counter()
family_results=[]
for ordinal,event in families:
    components=family_components[ordinal]
    local={"families":1,"genes":event["size"],"components":len(components),"bounded_components":sum(2<=len(c)<=500 for c in components),"bounded_component_genes":sum(len(c) for c in components if 2<=len(c)<=500),"oversized_components":sum(len(c)>500 for c in components),"oversized_component_genes":sum(len(c) for c in components if len(c)>500),"isolated_genes":sum(len(c)==1 for c in components)}
    counts.update(local)
    if event["size"]>500: counts.update({"over500_family_"+k:v for k,v in local.items()})
    family_results.append({"trace_ordinal":ordinal,"family":composition(event["members"]),"counts":local,"component_sizes":[len(c) for c in components],"component_compositions":[composition(c) for c in components]})
pair_path=repo/"benchmark_tools/results/deferred_pair_localization_independent_readback_20261013.json"
pair_readback=json.loads(pair_path.read_text())
paired_ref=pair_readback["checked"][0]
paired=json.loads(Path(paired_ref["path"]).read_text())
checked.extend([record(pair_path),paired_ref])
tables=[]
for arm in paired["arms"]:
    checked.append(arm["table"])
    with Path(arm["table"]["path"]).open() as stream: tables.append(list(csv.DictReader(stream,delimiter="\t")))
assert len(tables)==2 and all(len(t)==23934 for t in tables)
groups={}
for left,right in zip(*tables):
    assert all(left[k]==right[k] for k in ("left","right","reference_label","native_gene_left","native_gene_right","reference_is_cross_species","initial_hit_directions","forward_normalized_score","reverse_normalized_score"))
    x,y=index[left["native_gene_left"]],index[left["native_gene_right"]]
    fa,fb=int(family_owner[x]),int(family_owner[y])
    ca,cb=int(component_owner[x]),int(component_owner[y])
    if fa>=0 and fa==fb:
        kind=("bounded_same_component_context" if component_sizes[ca]<=500 else "oversized_same_component_singleton_fallback") if ca==cb else "different_components_same_family"
        size=next(e["size"] for o,e in families if o==fa)
        kind=("over500_family/" if size>500 else "bounded_family/")+kind
    elif fa>=0 and fb>=0: kind="different_large_eligible_families"
    elif fa>=0 or fb>=0: kind="one_large_eligible_family"
    else: kind="outside_large_copy_predicate"
    for key in ("transition:"+left["category"]+"->"+right["category"],"variant:"+right["category"]+"/"+right["stage"]):
        bucket=groups.setdefault(key,{"pairs":0,"component_context":Counter()})
        bucket["pairs"]+=1;bucket["component_context"][kind]+=1
assert sum(v["pairs"] for k,v in groups.items() if k.startswith("transition:"))==23934
for item in checked: check(item)
memory={k:v for k,v in (line.split(":",1) for line in Path("/proc/self/status").read_text().splitlines() if ":" in line)}
peak=int(memory["VmHWM"].split()[0])
wall=time.monotonic()-started
assert peak<=8*1024**2 and wall<=1200
write_json(output,{"status":"complete_all_large_copy_component_feasibility_verified","source_revision":plan["source_revision"],"checked":checked,"executed_sources":executed,"score_semantics_source_evidence_not_executed":semantic_source,"graph_fingerprint":plan["data"]["graph"]["fingerprint"],"component_min_edge_weight":1.5,"maximum_retained_component_genes":500,"accepted_edges":accepted_edges,"counts":dict(counts),"families":family_results,"reference_strata":groups,"ownership":ownership,"runtime":{"numpy":np.__version__,"biopython":Bio.__version__,"python":sys.version},"resources":{"wall_s":wall,"linux_postexec_vmhwm_kib":peak,"raw_self_ru_maxrss_kib_launch_history_scope":resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss},"analysis_recipe":os.environ["DIAGNOSTIC_RECIPE"],"new_inference":False,"defaults_promoted":False,"goal_completed":False})
print(json.dumps({"status":"complete","counts":counts,"remaining_separated":groups.get("variant:FN/candidate_separated"),"rescued":groups.get("transition:FN->TP"),"resources":{"wall_s":wall,"linux_postexec_vmhwm_kib":peak}},indent=2))
